title: Delivery-time and early-ownership issue mentions
summary: This topic clusters brief references to delivery timing, early ownership, dealer visits, and repeated tries, with only a few fragments clearly expressing dissatisfaction and many too incomplete to determine sentiment.

negative.summary: Negative fragments describe problems present since delivery or soon after delivery, including phone connectivity issues and an issue that required dealer attention despite eventual resolution.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments are mostly incomplete references to taking delivery, dealer visits, navigation or release attempts, and other early-ownership context without enough detail to confirm sentiment.

limitations: The topic mixes several loosely related subjects such as delivery timing, dealer service visits, repeated operation attempts, and feature behavior rather than one clearly coherent issue.
Most sampled fragments are short or incomplete, so the underlying problem and sentiment are often unclear.
The examples are stratified samples and are not representative estimates of the broader vehicle population or defect rates.
